hero.label: Cojauny Studio
hero.subheadline: A product-focused development studio. We build apps, web platforms, and consult on technology for European businesses.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: From idea to production. We cover the full product lifecycle.

items.title: App Development
items.description: Native and cross-platform mobile apps built with modern frameworks. iOS, Android, or both. We handle architecture, UI, and deployment end-to-end.

items.title: Web Development
items.description: Performant, SEO-optimized web platforms. From marketing sites to full-stack applications. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and modern tooling.

items.title: Technical Consulting
items.description: Architecture reviews, tech stack decisions, and team guidance. We help startups and established teams make better, faster technical choices.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: We understand your goals, constraints, and users. No assumptions.

steps.title: Architecture
steps.description: We design the right system for your use case — not for the next one.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: Clean, typed, tested code. Regular deliveries. Full transparency.

steps.title: Delivery & Support
steps.description: Deployment, documentation, and handover. We stay available after.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of products we have built and shipped.

items.title: Cojauny
items.description: A flight-sharing coordination platform connecting travelers on the same flight for shared transport. Full-stack product built from scratch.

items.title: Cuatro Sotas
items.description: Online multiplayer card game based on the traditional Spanish Guiñote. Features AI opponents, Bluetooth multiplayer, and global rankings.

items.title: FC Español Karlsruhe
items.description: Modern multilingual website for a Spanish football club based in Karlsruhe, Germany. Trilingual, CMS-driven, and fully responsive.

ecosystem.label: The ecosystem
ecosystem.title: Behind the studio, a product.
ecosystem.description: Cojauny Studio is the consulting and development arm of the Cojauny ecosystem. Our flagship product — Cojauny — is a flight-sharing app designed to connect travelers and reduce the cost and carbon footprint of airport transport. We build for others with the same standard we hold ourselves to.
